title: CHAPTER 2:UNDERSTANDING FOREIGN POLICY AND DIPLOMACY
content: ✨ እንኳን ወደ ሁለተኛው ምዕራፍ (Chapter 2) በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ ሀገራት የውጭ ፖሊሲ (Foreign Policy) ምንነት፣ የብሄራዊ ጥቅም (National Interest) ትርጉምና ክርክሮች፣ ብሄራዊ ጥቅም የሚመረኮዝባቸው 7 ዋና ዋና መስፈርቶች (Criteria)፣ እንዲሁም የሪአሊስቶችና አይዲያሊስቶች እይታን በጥልቀት እናያለን። በተጨማሪም የውጭ ፖሊሲ ግቦችን (Short, Middle, and Long-range objectives) እና መሳሪያዎችን በዝርዝር እንዳስሳለን በጣም አሪፍ ክፍል ነው ተከታተሉኝ እሽ👇👇👇。 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Chapter 2 Introduction: Foundations of Foreign Policy 🔹 What is Foreign Policy? - Foreign policy of a state refers to the actions, decisions, and goals that states pursue towards the outside world. - 👉 የውጭ ፖሊሲ ማለት አንድ ሀገር ከሌሎች ሀገራትና ከውጭው ዓለም ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ለመምራት የምትከተላቸው ውሳኔዎች፣ እርምጃዎች እና ግቦች ስብስብ ነው። 🔹 Factors Shaping Foreign Policy 1. External / Systemic Factors: International regimes, international organizations, and the prevalence/distribution of great powers at the global level. 2. Internal Factors: The economic, technological, and military capabilities of states heavily affect policy choices. 3. Individual Factors (Idiosyncrasy): The idiosyncrasy of leaders contributes much in affecting foreign policy making and implementation. - 👉 የውጭ ፖሊሲ በውጫዊ ሁኔታዎች (እንደ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶችና የኃያላን ሀገራት ተፅዕኖ)፣ በውስጣዊ አቅም (ኢኮኖሚ፣ ወታደራዊና ቴክኖሎጂ) እና በ መሪዎች ግላዊ ባህሪና ውሳኔ አሰጣጥ (Idiosyncrasy) የተቀረጸ ነው። 🔹 The Ultimate Motive: Pursuing National Interest. - States adopt foreign policy to achieve and promote their national interests, often defined through short-term, medium-term, and long-term goals. - 👉 የሁሉም ሀገራት የውጭ ፖሊሲ ዋነኛ መነሻና መሪ ምኞት ብሄራዊ ጥቅማቸውን (National Interest) ማስከበርና ማሳደግ ነው።በብሔራዊ ጥቅም እየማሉም ከነበሩት ከፍታ ዝቅ በማለት የግል ጥቅማቼውን የሚያካብቱም አይጠፉም በተለይ የአፍሪካ መሪዎች በዚህ ጉዳይ በ PHD ነው መሰለኝ ተወዳድረው የሚሾሙት😭። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.1. Defining National Interest 🔹 Core Meaning & Raison d'état - National Interest is the Raison d'état (the reason of state) used to justify actions and policies towards other states at the international level. - Refers to a set of values, orientations, goals, and objectives a given country would like to achieve in its international relations. - 👉 ብሄራዊ ጥቅም ማለት አንድ ሀገር በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለምትወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች እንደ ምክንያት (Raison d'état) የምታቀርበው፣ ሊሳኩ የሚገባቸው እሴቶችና ግቦች ስብስብ ነው። 🔹 Prominent Theoretical Definitions - A.K. Holsti: Defines national interest as "an image of the future state of affairs and future set of conditions that governments through individual policy makers aspire to bring about by wielding influence abroad and by changing or sustaining the behaviors of other states". - Key Instrument: Power (the ability to influence the behavior of other states) is the primary instrument to implement national interest. - Seabury: Defined national interest in two distinct ways: 1. Normative Sense: Set of purposes which a nation should seek to realize in the conduct of its foreign relations. 2. Descriptive Sense: Purposes which the nation through its leadership appears to pursue persistently over time. 🔹 The Science vs. Art Debate (Plato's Philosophy) - Is national interest an objective science or a subjective art/enterprise? This debate traces back to Plato's philosophy. - Plato's Perspective: The good of the polis (public good) is best determined by a Philosopher King aided by a few highly learned, detached, and fair-minded advisors without accounting for selfish pressures or lesser-minds. - 3 Basic Assumptions of Platonic/Authoritarian Decision-Making: 1. Wise decisions are made by a few carefully selected individuals expressly trained to think for the collective good. 2. These few individuals possessing awesome and unchecked power will not be corrupted by it. 3. Once optimal decisions are made, they can be implemented effectively by loyal, well-trained, and obedient bureaucracies. - Connection to Dictatorship: Authoritarian regimes use Plato's idea to emphasize the substance/wisdom of policy over procedural issues like public debate, consultation, and participation. - 👉 ፕላቶ እንደሚለው የህዝብ ጥቅም በጥቂት ጥበበኞች (Philosopher Kings) ሊወሰን ይገባል፤ ይህም ለአምባገነን (Authoritarian) አስተዳደሮች የህዝብ ውይይትንና ተሳትፎን ለማስወገድ እንደ ምክንያት ያገለግላል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Multiplicity of Criteria for Defining National Interest (Columbis) Foreign policy decision-making is rarely a clear-cut or purely rational process. Multiple conflicting criteria compete for priority in the minds of decision-makers. Official statements made for propaganda often cloud real motives. Columbis outlines the following key criteria: 1. Operational Philosophy: - Synoptic Style: Acting in a bold and sweeping fashion. Introducing major new practices/policies and discontinuing others, assuming sufficient information exists to predict and control outcomes. - Incremental Style: Acting with caution in a probing, experimental, trial-and-error fashion. Assumes problems are too complex for bold moves, seeking instead to perfect existing legislation, policies, and institutions. - 👉 ሲኖፕቲክ (በድፍረት አዲስ ፖሊሲ መቅረፅ) እና ኢንክሪመንታል (በጥንቃቄ እና ደረጃ በደረጃ ነባሩን ማሻሻል) ይለናል፣ይመቼው ደጋፊው ነኝ ከጎኔ ያላችሁ አጃችሁን አውጡ🙋‍♂️。 2. Ideological Criteria: - Governments identify friend or enemy countries using the litmus test of ideology (e.g., Communism vs. Capitalism during the Cold War). 3. Moral and Legal Criteria: - Moral: Acting honestly, keeping promises/treaties, avoiding exploitation/uneven development, and standing up for culture-accepted moral principles. - Legal: Abiding by rules of international law; acting in a general spirit of equity and justice where lacunas exist. 4. Pragmatic Criteria: - Low-key, matter-of-fact, rational analysis based on scientific cost-benefit assessment without normative, emotional, or personal sentiment judgments. 5. Professional Advancement Criteria: - Manipulating actions for personal success and survival in large bureaucracies without good governance. Marked by the "go along to get along" effect, strong conformity, and resistance to new policy thinking. 6. Partisan Criteria: - Equating the survival/success of a political party, ethnic group, religion, or specific bureaucratic agency (e.g., army vs. foreign office) with the national interest. 7. Foreign Dependency Criteria: - Common in Less Developed Countries (LDCs) that maintain colonial ties after independence, relying on ex-masters for aid, technology, expertise, and security. Makes independent national interest hard to defend. 💡 Exam Hint: የ Columbis 'Synoptic vs Incremental'፣ 'Pragmatic vs Moral' እና 'Foreign Dependency criteria' ለፈተና በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የሚጠየቁ ናቸው! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Realist vs. Idealist Debates on National Interest 🔹 Realist View (Hans Morgenthau) - Rejects ideological, legal, and moral criteria as utopian/impractical. - Defines National Interest strictly in terms of Pursuits of Power, Survival, and Security in an anarchical international system. - Power is the primary tool to control or influence others (diplomatically or co-ercively). - Prudence as Core Virtue: Morgenthau argues that prudence — the ability to assess one's needs/aspirations while carefully balancing them against capabilities and the needs of others — is the greatest virtue of a diplomat. Miscalculations led by ideological visions lead to chaos. - 👉 ሪአሊስቶች (በተለይ ሀንስ ሞርገንታው) ብሄራዊ ጥቅም ማለት የሀገርን ህልውናና ደህንነት በኃይል ማስጠበቅ ነው ይላሉ፤ ብልህ (Prudent) መሪ አቅሙንና ፍላጎቱን ያመጣጥናል። 🔹 Idealist View - Asserts that legal, moral, and ideological factors are constituting elements of national interest and are reflected in foreign policies (e.g., alliances, humanitarian intervention, foreign aid). - Global Solutions for Cross-Cutting Issues: Realists fail to address universal threats (e.g., environmental pollution, resource depletion, arms race, poverty, North-South gap). Idealists advocate for global institutions and collective solutions over narrow state-centric particularism. - 👉 አይዲያሊስቶች ለዓለም አቀፍ ችግሮች (እንደ አየር ንብረት ለውጥና ድህነት) በጋራና በዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት አማካኝነት መፍትሄ መፈለግ አለብን ይላሉ። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.2. Understanding Foreign Policy and Foreign Policy Behaviors 📌 2.2.1. Defining Foreign Policy & Its Core Objectives 🔹 Definition (Rochester): "The set of priorities and percepts established by national leaders to serve as guidelines for choosing among various courses of action in specific situations in international affairs." 🔹 Morgenthau's Core Minimum Goal: Survival 1. Physical Identity: Maintenance of territorial integrity. 2. Political Identity: Preservation of existing politico-economic systems. 3. Cultural Identity: Protection of ethnic, religious, linguistic, and historical norms. - 👉 የህልውና (Survival) ሶስቱ አዕማድ፡ የፖለቲካ፣ የባህል እና የቦታ/ግዛት (Territorial) ህልውናን ማስጠበቅ ናቸው። 🔹 Major Foreign Policy Instruments: - Diplomatic Bargaining (using carrot and stick / rewards and threats) - Economic Instruments (sanctions, trade, aid) - Propaganda - Sabotage / Terrorism - Use of Force (War) ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 2.2.2. Foreign Policy Objectives (K.J. Holsti Classification) Holsti classifies objectives based on 3 criteria: (1) Value placed on objective, (2) Time element, and (3) Demands imposed on other states. 1. Core Interests and Values (Short-Range Objectives): - Goals for which most people are willing to make ultimate sacrifices; sacrosanct principles of foreign policy. - Aimed at self-preservation of political/economic systems, culture, and territorial integrity. - Extraterritoriality: Projecting national claims beyond geographical boundaries (e.g., US, Israel considering conquered territories as strategic frontiers for core survival). - Includes protecting kin ethnic/religious groups or citizens living in neighboring states. - 👉 የአጭር ጊዜ (Core) ግቦች፡ የሀገር ህልውናና ነጻነትን ማስጠበቅ ሲሆኑ ህዝቡ ለማንኛውም መስዋዕትነት ዝግጁ የሚሆንላቸው የተቀደሱ ግቦች ናቸው። 2. Middle-Range Objectives: - Focus on satisfying domestic economic betterment and social welfare needs (jobs, income, medical services) through international action. - Includes trade, foreign aid, access to communication facilities, and foreign markets. - Varies drastically depending on economic, technological, and military capabilities of states. - 👉 የመካከለኛ ጊዜ ግቦች፡ የህዝብን የኢኮኖሚና የማህበራዊ እድገት ፍላጎት በዓለም አቀፍ ንግድና እርዳታ አማካኝነት ማሟላት ላይ ያተኩራሉ። 3. Long-Range Objectives: - Plans, dreams, and visions concerning the ultimate political or ideological reconstruction of the entire international system according to a universal vision. - Makes universal demands without strict time limits; requires substantial power and capability to exert real international influence. - 👉 የረጅም ጊዜ ግቦች፡ ሙሉውን የዓለም አቀፍ ስርዓት በራስ ርዕዮተ-ዓለምና እይታ መልሶ የመገንባት ታላላቅ ህልሞች ናቸው። ይሄ ነገር ለአፍሪካ መሪዎች ፈፅሞ ትዝ የሚላቼው አይመስለኝም። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ይህንን ከሞጁሉ የተወሰደ ሙሉ እና ዝርዝር ኖት ደጋግማችሁ በማጥናት ለፈተናችሁ ብቁ ሁኑ። በቀጣዩ ክፍል 2 ( PART 2) እስከምንገናኝ መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ! 🙏🙏🙏
